First beta of binference: an AI agent that trades on BNB Smart Chain for you from Telegram, a web console or the terminal, and asks before every transaction.
Swaps, limit orders, take-profit, stop-loss, DCA, copy trades, alerts and webhook rules. You start on paper; live trading needs binference live and its typed disclaimer.
Send to your address book and .bnb names, bridge to Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Solana and Robinhood Chain, and stake BNB with StakeHub or Lista.
Your wallets stay in Privy under a ceiling only your owner key can change. Freeze, rescue and limits work from the terminal and Telegram at any time.
In this beta, auto orders and webhook rules fill on paper only. Live fills stay off until they are proven.
